definitions.M: the forward-merge commit of main@origin into legion/INFRA-512 (main with every child), the GC pass's base
definitions.H: the root head after the GC pass
definitions.B0: first parent on main of the earliest-merged fix child's merge commit (gh api repos/sjawhar/legion/commits/<sha> --jq '.parents[0].sha')
definitions.windowBytesT: end heap profile total alloc_space minus start heap profile total, each read alone; never the 'of N total' of a -diff_base read (it prints the base's total: 132.87 GB vs the true 89.48 GB on the old replay)
definitions.allocationSite: a function of github.com/sjawhar/envoy/..., credited with the window bytes whose innermost Dispatch frame it is: flat column of go tool pprof -top -nodecount=1000000 -nodefraction=0 -edgefraction=0 -sample_index=alloc_space -diff_base=<start> '-show=^github\.com/sjawhar/envoy/' <bin> <end>
definitions.profileOfRecord: window allocation profile of the median-CPU run of the three M runs; one pass, no second profile
definitions.expectedGain: E = sum over fixed sites of f_s*b_s/T*G + f_s*m_s; f_s from a per-site benchmark B/op, m_s = CPU under the site in runtime.mallocgc
definitions.mergeRule: S = max(M) - min(M) CPU-seconds; E >= S: every H run below every M run; E < S: the -focus share of GC regex plus fixed sites in the median H profile is lower than in the median M profile by >= E/median(M)/2; plus each site's flat bytes in the median H window profile below its bytes in the profile of record, or the site comes out and is written up on INFRA-512

tasks: 1 Preflight: every child done; main's loadtest has INFRA-639 acceptance 6/7/9; no SetGCPercent/SetMemoryLimit/GOGC/GOMEMLIMIT outside tests
2 Forward merge: jj new legion/INFRA-512 main@origin (architect-approved 14:51Z), push without skip-checks; every child merge commit is an ancestor of M

4 Seed/migration check: B0's highest migration >= seed.meta.json .migration (else reseed with B0's build, used for every side); no backfill owed or running inside any window (migrated seed copy if needed)
5 Three M runs, alternated with the three B0 runs: box_busy_before <= 0.10, committed == offered, Dispatch peak 5 s cores < 0.9 x GOMAXPROCS

6 Site table from the profile of record (every site >= 2%, qualifying >= 5%), allocating lines via -list; INFRA-514-lane sites (docs/fold.go history fold, coldFork) to the architect with bytes and a proposed fix; ygo-only fixes to the architect as a decision; table posted on INFRA-512
7 Design each fix with f_s and E; no sync.Pool or buffer kept beyond one request without Sami's decision through the architect; outputs byte-identical

8 Per-site benchmark and anti-aliasing test on generated real-size documents (no LINUX content in the public tree); throwaway corpus comparison over 1,157 LINUX specs under $TMPDIR; CHANGELOG entry; AGENTS.md where a changed function is described
9 go test ./internal/dispatch/... ./cmd/dispatch/..., go vet ./..., -tags memory suite, -race on changed packages, INFRA-179 grep
10 Three H runs; merge rule; per-site byte drop (failing sites removed, H re-run); heap in use p50 and RSS max <= highest M run

11 Deliverable 3 comment and six profile artifacts on INFRA-512 (B0/M/H SHAs, inputs, CPU-seconds and cores at full rate beside production's 10.9-14.0, T, GC split, W-row partition at each end, commits B0..H touching Dispatch's server marked by tree, each child's merge-rule result, what the replay does not reproduce)
12 No qualifying in-lane site: the pull request carries a docs/solutions note of deliverable 3 plus the INFRA-512 comment (architect 15:00Z)
13 Pull request body: Dispatch: INFRA-512, E2E lines, site table, f_s, E, 3+3 runs, S, rule branch, per-site bytes, deliverable 3; no private names
14 After any later commit under packages/envoy: re-run H and re-post before READY; diff posted H..READY head under packages/envoy empty
